quotes.quote: Agent identities are identity accounts within Microsoft Entra ID that provide unique identification and authentication capabilities for AI agents.
Enforce least-privilege access by controlling which users, data, and tools or MCP servers agents can use.
New Just-in-Time (JIT) provisioning with conditions, plus effective privilege visibility, replaces always-on access for people, service accounts, and AI agents alike.
The policy remains outside the agent workload’s control, so the agent or generated code cannot grant itself additional access.
Every decision resolves to allow, deny or escalate, and an escalated action waits for a named reviewer before it proceeds.
It does not operate your agents or step into their decisions, so they keep running exactly as your teams built them.
Next, you can monitor AI agents’ status throughout their lifecycle to help ensure only approved agents are deployed to your IT landscape.
Island sits where AI is used: browser, endpoint, network, every tool call.
